known_limitations: Trained on synthetic trade data only; has not been validated against real Stellar DEX activity. Cold-start pairs (fewer than 50 labelled trades) fall back to the Neural Process blend described in docs/cold_start.md.
intended_use: Wash-trade risk scoring for Stellar DEX asset pairs, as an input to the LedgerLens ensemble scorer.
out_of_scope_uses: Not intended for automated enforcement action or as sole evidence in a regulatory filing without human review.
